info.title: GDS Preview API
info.description: Creates live preview deployments of React apps built with the GDS (Gofore Design System). Send React component code and receive a unique preview URL.

post.description: Receives React/TSX code for App.tsx (and optional extra component files), wraps it in a Vite + GDS template, and deploys it to Vercel. Returns a unique preview URL.

appCode.description: The full contents of src/App.tsx. Must export a default React component. Use GDS imports: GDSProvider is already wrapped in main.tsx, so App.tsx should import UI components from @chakra-ui/react and @gdesignsystem/react.

extraFiles.description: Optional additional source files. Keys must start with 'src/' (e.g. 'src/components/Header.tsx'). Values are the full file contents as strings.

title.description: Optional page title for the HTML document. Defaults to 'GDS Preview'.

previewUrl.description: The unique URL where the preview is deployed (e.g. https://gds-preview-a1b2c3d4.vercel.app)

previewId.description: Short unique ID for this preview

400.description: Invalid request (missing appCode, blocked code patterns)
